data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Mureil is derived from the name of the sea god, Murias. The name Mureil signifies a protector or defender of the sea and its creatures. This name is deeply rooted in ancient Greek spirituality and is a perfect choice for a little boy who embodies the strength, power, and nurturing qualities of the sea.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector of the sea and its creatures.
data.etymology: Mureil belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sea god's protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mureil total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The Christian name "Mureil" has its origins in Greek mythology, honoring the significance of the sea god, Murias, who was believed to protect and shield the sea and its inhabitants.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Mureil" embodies the protective and nurturing qualities of the sea god and is a powerful reminder of God's infinite love and protection. It is a spiritual name that inspires one to be a defender of truth, justice, and goodness in their own sphere of influence. It also signifies resilience and strength in the face of adversity, much like the unwavering nature of the sea.
